source_tests: P5-11 Covered California RFP 2026-01 fresh-request usability smoke test

findings.observed: Generic Request for Proposal metadata contributed to RFP and RFQ Preparation alignment even though solicitation preparation was not the requested service.
findings.treatment: Remove generic request-for-proposal/request-for-quotation metadata terms from ICM-PRC-004 positive keywords while retaining substantive preparation/development terms.
findings.safety_result: No autonomous action occurred; correction reduces inflated fit screening.

findings.observed: A verification-rights passage was classified as IP Ownership Assignment with 0.9946 confidence on public-sector text.
findings.treatment: Do not retrain or rewrite frozen Project 4 evidence. Preserve the error as error-analysis evidence and make the operator warning explicit that domain-shift safeguards override confidence for consequential interpretation.
findings.safety_result: MODEL_DOMAIN_SHIFT forced escalation; no legal conclusion or autonomous action occurred.

findings.observed: One FAR record was retrieved but the assessment remained insufficient at 0.266 and 0/3 claims were sufficient.
findings.treatment: Retain as evidence-layer safeguard example; retrieval is not treated as sufficient support.

findings.observed: Markdown table headers can collapse in Colab rendering.
findings.treatment: Render the operator-facing packet as a table-free sectioned Markdown view while preserving canonical packet JSON/Markdown artifacts.

findings.observed: Structured estimated value rendered as a raw Python-style dictionary.
findings.treatment: Format structured monetary values as human-readable currency in the operator view without changing underlying JSON.

production_boundary: Controlled capstone prototype; nonbinding recommendations only; no autonomous external action; final human authority required.
